component.name: Permafrost
component.summary: Block distractions until the timer runs out

description.p: Permafrost blocks distracting websites and apps for as long as you choose. Lock a freeze and it can’t be stopped early, even by restarting your computer.

ul.li: Block websites and apps with ready-made lists for social media, video, news, shopping, games and adult content
Freeze for 25 minutes or a whole day, or block on a weekly schedule
Locked lists can only get stricter until the timer ends
Force SafeSearch on Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and YouTube
